_format_note: CVS training-config layout. Top-level order: (1) cvs params at root, (2) container (incl. its env), (3) train_params (canonical keys + framework passthrough under maxtext_config), (4) tests blocks at root, (5) sweeps + runs. run_mode/nnodes/nic_type are handled internally; the NCCL device selection and JAX distributed knobs are exact env-var names inside container.env.

container.name: rocm-jaxmaxtext-mi35x-llama3.1-70b-single
container._env_comment: Static ENV exported into the container on every node. Per-node/dynamic vars (JAX_COORDINATOR_IP, NNODES, NODE_RANK, JAX_PROCESS_INDEX) and credentials (HF_TOKEN, HF_HOME, LD_LIBRARY_PATH, PYTHONPATH) are injected by the launcher and must NOT be set here. NCCL_IB_*/*_SOCKET_IFNAME/NCCL_IB_GID_INDEX are the cluster-specific RDMA/NIC device selection (shipped as <changeme>; distributed runs hard-exit at config load until set). JAX_COORDINATOR_PORT / JAX_DISTRIBUTED_* are the JAX coordinator knobs.

_train_params_comment: Canonical training params + framework passthrough. hf_model_id drives the tokenizer download from HuggingFace (skipped for dataset_type=synthetic). model_name (the MaxText preset) also labels the run/report and tokenizer_path is the download target -- both live in maxtext_config. Set an explicit model_id here only if a friendlier CVS label than the preset name is wanted. steps and enable_checkpointing live in maxtext_config. xla_flags stays structured here and is exported as a single XLA_FLAGS string.

train_params._model_name_comment: model_name selects the MaxText model preset (layers/heads/dims). Kept in maxtext_config so the run trains Llama-3.1-70B rather than base.yml defaults.

_convergence_comment: to enable validation loss set eval_interval > 0 (and eval_steps) in maxtext_config; needs a validation dataset. target_value <= 0 disables convergence (record-only). target_metric 'auto' uses eval_loss when eval runs, else training loss.
_loss_curve_comment: Sample training loss every `sample_every` steps (plus milestone_steps) and pass when the least-squares slope < max_slope. enforce=false makes it record-only.
_smoke_comment: Smoke test (test_smoke), ENABLED by default. Loads the model and runs `steps` steps at a small fixed batch/seqlen in BF16; passes if no error signature fires (no metric checks). A failure gates the rest of the suite. Set enabled=false to SKIP it during iterative experiments (opt-out). steps/per_device_batch_size/max_target_length tune the smoke run.
_checkpoint_resume_comment: Opt-in checkpoint save+resume + I/O-time test. enabled=false -> skipped. Runs ONE sweep twice: train steps_before_ckpt (checkpoint at checkpoint_period), then resume + train steps_after_resume; passes if it restarts from the checkpoint step and the boundary loss matches within loss_tolerance. max_save/load_seconds gate I/O time (0 = record-only). smoke_model_overrides can shrink the model while keeping the tokenizer/vocab; empty = full model. delete_ckpt_dir=true frees disk after the test.
_error_patterns_comment: name -> regex scanned in each node's training.log during polling; a match fails that sweep's run with the matched name. Remove this block to use built-in defaults.

error_patterns.NCCL ERROR: NCCL ERROR|NCCL timeout|local work queue catastrophic error
error_patterns.GPU HW ERROR: HW Exception by GPU|GPU Hang|Uncorrectable error|GPU Reset
error_patterns.AssertionError: AssertionError|ValueError:|JaxStackTrace|During handling of the above exception|triggered the following exception
error_patterns.rocm Err: FAILED_PRECONDITION: No visible GPU devices|failed call to hipInit: HIP_ERROR_NoDevice|librocm reported version is: NOT_FOUND
error_patterns.python err: ModuleNotFoundError: No module named|Fatal Python error:

_sweeps_comment: combinations{} + runs[] shape. Each combination = one full training run; the key is the threshold cell key. Values are per-run overrides applied on top of train_params.maxtext_config. `runs` selects which combinations to execute. The key is a compact label only (NN<nodes>_ST<steps>_<precision>_B<batch>_SL<seqlen>); real values come from the overrides. FP8 on MI300X/MI325X (CDNA3) uses quantization=nanoo_fp8.
